title: Senior Manager, Product Management - Back Office Servicing Experiences

requirements.text: Lead the SCRA and Specialty Operations domains and set the strategy for high-visibility back-office capabilities
Lead and grow two product managers owning critical back-office servicing workflows
Partner with several dedicated tech teams
Lead a cross-functional group across Risk, Legal, Operations, and Business Analysis
Set and deliver a multi-year roadmap to automate back-office operations using AI and cloud data
Own the end-to-end customer and agent experience for regulatory and specialty programs
Expand capabilities like SCRA across more lines of business
Partner with Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Operations so every experience is compliant, well-governed, and built to scale
Replace manual agent tasks with intelligent automation
Configure and ship user-centric servicing experiences on existing enterprise platforms
Demonstrate proficiency in Human Centered: obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Demonstrate proficiency in Business Focused: delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Demonstrate proficiency in Technology Driven: leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable near term and long term value
Demonstrate proficiency in Integrated Problem Solving: identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Demonstrate proficiency in Transformational Leadership: leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field), Business or Marketing, with the degree obtained on or before the scheduled start date
Alternative to the degree requirement: Bachelor's degree in any field and at least 4 years of Product Management experience
Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products
Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position
